name: m2t6
description: Military slice fixture on an open all-grass field: a player-one militia equips Forge weapons and armor straight off the commodity ledger (SPEC §2.5 'equipment = commodities'), an archer trains through the archery-range queue as a full combatant, and both then attack-move across the map toward a formation destination. En route an idle player-two scout-cavalry stands inside their aggro radii: the marchers pause with Attack heads, close, trade blows on the reload cadence (the scout auto-retaliates once) and kill it, after which both engagements purge and the attack-moves RESUME automatically, delivering each unit onto its concentric-ring slot at the destination. Milestone digests land every 30th tick plus final; the run doubles as the extended determinism canary.
